candidates: Timeout and MemorySize properties of CompressionFunction in the IaC template
answer.explanation: CompressionFunction is the only function with a failure pattern: most of its invocations in the window end with Status: timeout at exactly 3000.00 ms, and it is billed for the full 3 s. Its Max Memory Used stays at 95-98 MB against a 128 MB allocation, so memory exhaustion is not the cause. The other functions, at 256 MB or 1024 MB, complete in roughly 15-200 ms with no timeouts. The 128 MB setting gives the function a small CPU share, and the 3 s timeout leaves little headroom for its work plus cold-start initialisation (Init Duration of about 400-500 ms in several timed-out invocations). Together these point to an undersized live configuration rather than a permission or code fault. No AccessDenied errors appear in the visible logs, so IAM is not indicated. I did not have the IaC template or change history to confirm whether the values were deployed as intended.
